title: CatDetectionPayload
description: Payload for cat_detection events, emitted once per confirmed cat presence event when it ends (PEN-248, change: add-cat-detection-identification). Phase 1 always sets predicted_identity/final_identity to "unknown" and identification_confidence to null, since no identification model runs yet.

event_start_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the first of the N consecutive frames that confirmed this event (matches CatEventLifecycle's _pending_start_time, not the frame that completed confirmation)

event_end_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when cat presence was last observed before the absence cooldown elapsed. Null only if a future emission point ever fires before the event closes; V1 emits exactly once, at close, so this is always populated in practice.

predicted_identity.description: Top predicted identity regardless of confidence threshold. Fixed to "unknown" in Phase 1 (no identification model wired in).

final_identity.description: predicted_identity if identification confidence is at or above the configured threshold, else "unknown". Fixed to "unknown" in Phase 1.

detection_confidence.description: Detector confidence from the most recently observed present frame before the event ended (not necessarily the confirming frame)

identification_confidence.description: Identification confidence for predicted_identity. Null in Phase 1, where no identification model runs.

device_id.description: Source device identifier (e.g. rpi-camera-01), duplicated from the envelope for payload-level querying

model_version.description: Version of the detection model (and identification model once Phase 2 is wired in) used for this event

pipeline_version.description: Version of the edge/vision pipeline that produced this event
